label: Second copy step (output original token 1) in long sequences (L>=8)
explanation: Fires only at step t = L+1 (right after the first copied token is input; outputting original token 1), essentially never elsewhere (6 of 56.5k activations at recall_idx 2, none in original/delimiter phases). Strongly length-gated: 75% of mass at L=9, 22% at L=8, 3% at L=7, ~0 for L<=6. Within eligible steps it fires on only ~46% of L=9 and ~19% of L=8 sequences; firing and magnitude rise when the early original tokens (orig 1-3, i.e. the upcoming outputs) are from {i, s, n, 1, v} (adding that condition raises precision to ~0.53-0.72 at lower recall). Mostly gives graded small activations (median 0.6); top activations are L=9 sequences whose 2nd-4th tokens are s/i/n/1. Does not fire on the delimiter step, the first copy step, or later copy steps.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the next token to output (most: s, i, 1, n, v, x; least: -, q, e, o) and the token being output, by phase (copy phase: i, s, v, 1; input phase: ; delimiter step: ); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=1, L=9 & t=10, L=8 & t=9.
